description: Check one unsigned Base transaction and return SAFE or RISKY. Uses the simulation, flags an unlimited approval or approval-for-all, flags a hidden token move, and runs one exit check on a token the call approves or swaps. Nothing is signed or broadcast. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Base only). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

data.description: 0x calldata, required unless raw is set

from.description: address that would send the transaction (0x...)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

raw.description: serialized unsigned transaction instead of to and data

to.description: contract the call targets (0x...), required unless raw is set

name: tx_check
title: Tx check
